text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! Time to get down to
business as
the class representative
today as well!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Class Representative! You don't
need to push
yourself all the time! You
should put your feet up
sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Kind Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Juggling responsibilities and racing
takes a toll on
your body. Let your
classmates help with your
class
representative duties!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your feelings of admiration for the class

representative have been conveyed! I
will not let
them fall on deaf ears.
Today, I'll act as an
"ordinary student."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone! It's about time
we
started the class.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, one moment please! As the class

representative, it's my duty to clear the

blackboard first...

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! You're an ordinary student
today! I'm
on duty, so I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Y-you're right... I'm just a student
right now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the class representative, the
well-intentioned
actions of her
classmates are an unimaginable
hardship.
